note.en: Across your week, include a vertical pull, a row and a controlled hip hinge; choose versions you can control, progress gradually and leave time to recover.
note.zh: 一周的训练里，安排一个垂直拉、一个划船和一个受控的髋铰链动作；选自己控制得住的做法，循序渐进，并留出恢复时间。

title.en: A way to arrange a back session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种背部训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Warm up with a high bar and an easy body angle; check the bar is secure and get used to moving the shoulder blades.
note.zh: 用较高的横杆和较容易的身体角度热身；先确认横杆稳固，再熟悉肩胛骨的动作。

note.en: Do the main hip hinge while you are fresh, building up from a light load; the hips and knees move while the spine holds still.
note.zh: 趁精力充足做主项髋铰链，从轻重量逐步加上去；动的是髋和膝，脊柱保持不动。

note.en: Use a comfortable grip and keep the trunk still; pick a load that still lets the bar return smoothly.
note.zh: 握法要舒服，躯干保持不动；选一个能让横杆平稳回去的重量。

note.en: Support yourself on the bench and give each side the same careful attention.
note.zh: 撑在凳子上，两边都一样认真地做。

note.en: Finish with an easy shoulder-blade control movement, without added weight at first.
note.zh: 最后做一个简单的肩胛控制动作，一开始先不加重量。

note.en: Use a very light dumbbell and turn under control; stop before the trunk or elbow starts to help.
note.zh: 用很轻的哑铃，有控制地转；躯干或手肘开始代偿之前就停。

note.en: This order practises technique before you tire and puts lighter shoulder work at the end; not every exercise in the list belongs in one session. Rest until you can control the movement again, and adapt the choice with a qualified coach. This is general information, not medical advice; for pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
note.zh: 这个顺序是在疲劳之前先练技术，较轻的肩部动作放在最后；动作列表里的动作不必全塞进同一节课。休息到能重新控制动作再继续，并请合格的教练帮你调整选择。本页是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
